label: Model Settings
title: Project — Model Settings
subtitle: Override the global model, temperature, and inference strategy for this project.
description: The Model Settings tab lets you choose a different model, temperature, or context strategy for this specific project. Any field left blank inherits the global default.

settings.name: Model Override
settings.description: The model used for all agents in this project, replacing the global default. Leave blank to inherit. The picker is searchable: type part of a model name, its id, or its provider to narrow the list.

settings.name: Temperature Override
settings.description: Project-specific creativity level. Leave blank to inherit the global value.

settings.name: Max Tokens Override
settings.description: Project-specific response length limit. Leave blank to inherit. Choosing a model that cannot produce the limit you have set brings it down to what that model can; a model that can already produce it leaves it alone. While the field is blank it shows the chosen model’s own output limit, and stays blank until you set a value.

settings.name: Custom Parameters
settings.description: Additional model parameters (top-p, top-k, reasoning effort) applied to all agents in the project.

settings.name: Inference Strategy
settings.description: How the model is called — Best of N (multiple candidates, highest score wins), Self-Consistency (majority vote), Chain-of-Thought with Reflection (reason then self-review), or Plan Search (evaluate plans before executing).

mediaCaption: Project model settings showing an overridden model with a 'Reset to global default' link beneath the selector
tips: Model overrides only affect this project — your global default is unchanged and other projects are not affected.
If you are experimenting with a new model, set it here first before changing the global default.
